name: Doomcryer
notes: A Warcryer is a buffer first; its own damage is about a third of a Tyrant's (Wikibooks).
Base and Orc Shaman bands are the same as the Dominator line (classes 49, 50).
The 76-85 table lists only the Doomcryer additions: the Warcryer rows are kept below (why: "kept from the 40-75 Warcryer table").
Open question: do the board buffs include Greater Might, Greater Shield, Arcane Protection or prophecies? That decides War Chant and Chant of Spirit.

rows.trig: Pull with Chill Flame (DoT) or Venom, then Life Drain, then melee with a blunt or staff.
Or pull with Venom (poison DoT), then Life Drain, then melee.
Stun Attack (blunt): the melee part, after Life Drain.
Blaze Quake (PB DoT, 35 % land rate) only when >= 3 mobs are already on you. Low value.
Seal of Poison only when >= 3 mobs are already on you. Low value.
Board-duplicate chant (Pa'agrian Gift = board Might): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Blessings of Pa'agrio = board Shield): only if the board buff is missing.
Board-duplicate chant (Soul Shield = board Shield): only if the board buff is missing.
CC: Seal of Binding (root): root an add while the party kills the main target.
CC: Seal of Slow on an add while the party kills the main target.

Chant of Victory (5 min; 40 Spirit Ore; 5 min reuse; party heal 20 %, Max HP +20 %, Atk.Spd x1.2, crit damage x1.2, M.Atk/M.Def x1.2, speed -20 %). Fighter party: before every raid or hard pull, and on cooldown while fighting tough content. Not for trash if Spirit Ore is scarce.

when.text: the party is mostly casters (then instead of Chant of Victory 1363)

rows.trig: Burst, mage party: Magnus' Chant (same slot as Victory) instead of Victory when the party is mostly casters. Never cast both.
20-min unique: Chant of Elements (+20 resistance to all four elements): keep up always.
20-min unique: Chant of Spirit (debuff/cancel resistance): keep up always; skip it if board Arcane Protection is on.
Chant of Protection (crit damage received x0.7) is already in the board's Warrior scheme, so cast it only when it's missing.
Arcane Wisdom (MP cost x0.7, cast speed x0.9, drains HP) on during long buff rounds. Off in combat when HP < 50 %.
rows.why: owner rule 2026-10-10: toggles only in fights; buff rounds outside fights need the owner's OK

rows.trig: Never: Gate Chant (manual party summon).
